title: Nano-biochar supported Zn delivery in plants to enhance seedling growth and ROS management in rice
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00578C, Paper
Poonam Sashidhar, Kalyan Yakkala, Rupam Kumar Bhunia, Suparna Patowary, Mandira Kochar, Shovon Mandal, Lambert Brau, David Cahill, Mukul Dubey
Rice husk (RH) is a major agro-waste in rice-producing countries, presents major management challenges. RH biochar (RHB) is applied for soil amelioration, and its properties can be modified to better meet the needs of specific crops.
